name: ManyVids
summary: Indie creator marketplace built around a-la-carte clip purchases, custom video orders, creator clubs, and live cams—complete with real category search.
ranking_rationale: Standout pick for viewers who prefer buying individual indie clips over juggling monthly subscriptions, supported by strong search and custom-request tools.

pricing.model: A-la-carte clip store + optional creator clubs & live streams
pricing.free_tier: Free browsing and short clip previews; clips and clubs priced per creator
pricing.notes: Clip prices, custom videos, and club subscriptions are set per creator; no site-wide monthly fee required.

pros: Buy individual clips a la carte without recurring subscriptions
Actual category search, tags, and previews for discovering creators
Built-in custom video requests, physical store items, and live cams
cons: Individual clip prices can add up faster than an all-access studio pass
Interface mixes clips, clubs, and cams in a busy layout
Production polish ranges from studio-grade to webcam-casual

facts.value: Indie creator clip store and club platform
A-la-carte video purchases plus optional creator clubs and tips
Searchable indie clip marketplace with custom video ordering
